dog.description_text:
This pet needs emergency placement. Please click here to go to our emergency placement page for more information.

This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Cookie butter is at risk due to behavioral reasons. While in care, Cookie Butter has been observed to have a low threshold for arousal. Noted to fixate on a handler after being spoken to in a soft voice. He will also run and spin around while on leash. In one instance Cookie Butter was noted to thrash, vocalize, circle the handler, and alligator roll while on a walk. Cookie Butter is noted to be receptive to when the handler speaks to him softly and is receptive to treats and verbal cues. Medically, he is apparently healthy.

Cookie Butter arrived at MACC as a stray with no known history. While in care, Cookie has been observed to thrash, vocalize, circle the handler, and alligator role while on a walk. Cookie butter has been noted to have a low threshold for arousal. Cookie butter is noted to be responsive to when the handler speaks to him softly. He is also noted to struggle with impulse control. He has been noted to fixate on handlers and be unable to be redirected. We recommend placement with a New Hope partner who can provide any necessary behavior modification (force-free, positive reinforcement-based) and re-evaluate behavior in a stable home environment before placement into a permanent home.
